titulo: ‘Scott and Damien are afraid’: senior Liberal quizzed at Icac about former staffer’s message
cuerpo: NSW shadow attorney general, Damien Tudehope, tells inquiry Jean-Claude Perrottet had a talent for recruiting A senior New South Wales Liberal says the younger brother of former Liberal premier Dominic Perrottet had a “talent” for recruiting and renewing new members to the party, a corruption inquiry has heard. On Tuesday, Damien Tudehope, the NSW shadow attorney general and Liberal leader in the upper house, gave evidence as part of the Independent Commission Against Corruption ’s (Icac) Operation Rosny, where he was also asked about a 2018 message in which his former staffer Jean-Claude Perrottet wrote to other Reformers that “Scott and Damien are afraid”.
